contexts.text: She took a veil and covered herself () = the appearances of truth; for the veil with which brides covered their faces when they first saw the bridegroom, = the appearance of truth. Explained.
She covered herself with a veil () = truth obscured. Explained.
That the truth of the Church has been obscured to (the Jews) is represented also at this day by their covering themselves with veilsin their synagogues. Further illustrated.
She removed her veil from her () = that what was obscure was dissipated.
